title: Merge PDF – Combine PDF Files Free, No Upload | OpenAnyDoc
description: Merge PDF files into one in your browser: put them in order and download a single PDF. Free, no sign-up, no watermark, and nothing is ever uploaded.
heading: Merge PDF
subtitle: Combine several PDF files into one, in the order you choose, right in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your PDFs are combined by your own browser. They are never sent to a server, so nobody else ever sees them.

features.title: Free with no limits
features.text: No account, no watermark and no daily cap on files or merges.

features.title: Works offline
features.text: Once this page has loaded, merging keeps working without an internet connection.

steps.title: Choose your PDFs
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop two or more PDF files anywhere on the page. You can add more at any time.

steps.title: Put them in order
steps.text: Move each file up or down. The merged PDF follows this order, page by page.

steps.title: Merge and download
steps.text: Click Merge PDF, then download the combined file. Nothing leaves your device.

limits: PDFs that need a password to open can't be merged; remove the password first.
Bookmarks and fillable form fields of the original files may not carry over to the merged PDF.
Very large sets of files are limited by your device's memory.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your PDFs are read and merged by your browser, on your device, and are never sent anywhere. You can check it yourself: open your browser's network panel while you merge and you will see no upload.

faq.question: How many PDFs can I merge?
faq.answer: As many as you like. There is no cap on files or pages; only very large sets are limited by your device's memory.

faq.question: Will the quality of my PDF change?
faq.answer: No. Pages are copied as they are, so text, images and fonts keep their original quality, and text stays selectable.

faq.question: Can I merge password-protected PDFs?
faq.answer: Not yet. A PDF that needs a password to open can't be read here. Remove the password in the app you use to open it, then merge it.

faq.question: Does it work on my phone?
faq.answer: Yes. It works in any modern browser on Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac and Linux, with no app to install.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.
